info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Insurance Claims Claims Payouts-v5-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Payout API provides access to detailed information regarding payouts associated with insurance claims. Users can retrieve a comprehensive list of claims payouts, which serves as a valuable resource for insurance adjusters, claims analysts, and audit teams. This API facilitates efficient claims management and ensures that stakeholders can access timely and accurate payout data. Typical use cases include auditing, reporting, and enhancing decision-making processes related to claims handling.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch detailed information regarding claims payouts, facilitating data retrieval for analysis and reporting purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve payout information for claims. It should include the necessary parameters to specify the claims for which the payout details are requested.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsPayoutsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to claims payout.
